case_classification.short_description: Loan Amortization Schedule for a Constant Principal Loan

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task requires building a 10-year monthly loan amortization schedule with non-standard compounding (bi-weekly compounding for monthly payments) and beginning-of-period payments under a Constant Principal structure. An expert modeler will need to carefully calculate the effective period rate, set up the 120-month schedule with correct timing for interest accrual and principal payments, and build a summary to answer 25 detailed date-specific and year-specific questions. Setting up the formulas, validating that the balance reaches zero at maturity, and mapping the answers will take approximately 50 minutes.
